name: unipile
description: The Unipile LinkedIn API, plus WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, email and calendar APIs, inside Claude. Claude searches the API reference, reads the exact schema of each route and tests calls on your own connected test accounts.

api_key.title: Unipile scoped API key (optional)
api_key.description: Scoped Account API key from dashboardv2.unipile.com. Leave empty to only read the API reference. Needed to run requests on the test accounts assigned to the key's Scope.
